detail.longDescription:
See all the latest news about Linux (Ubuntu, Fedora), Containers (Docker, CoreOS), Web development platforms and frameworks (node.js, Bootstrap), Databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB) and many others aggregated across dozens of news outlets, sites and blogs.

Skim quickly over the recent news and save specific items for review later.

Save hours weekly by seeing all news items from the most popular websites in one place, without compromising on content quality.

Features:
- Full coverage from top software news sources in one app - a clean, prioritized feed and no repeat stories

- Push notifications - specific topics that interest you, or prominent events

- Topics management - choose your favorite topics (like "Debian" or "SQLite"), block certain topics and choose the topics you want to get notifications about! Read only what you want, get notified on only what interests you, and the configuration is easy and quick!

- Save articles inside the app for later reading

- Join the community and post polls, comment on stories, tag articles and earn Points & Badges!

- Block source and it's articles won't show again

- Collapsed mode for super fast reading

Love the app? Give us a five star rating, write a review and share the app with your friends!
